Job Description:
 Treasury Technology Developer 

 About Jain Global 
 Jain Global is an innovative multi-strategy / multi-manager investment firm founded on the basis of achieving scale on Day 1 across regions, markets, and investors. With over 400 employees operating from offices in New York, Houston, London, Singapore, and Hong Kong, we are looking to add to our growing teams.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Build and maintain full stack applications supporting Treasury functions using React and Python
 Develop APIs and backend services to support cash management, liquidity, funding, and treasury workflows
 Work with databases and data platforms including Snowflake and AWS RDS
 Collaborate with Treasury, Product, Data, and Engineering teams to deliver scalable technology solutions
 Design, develop, and enhance applications that improve operational efficiency and automation across Treasury processes
 Debug and optimize systems across frontend, backend, and data layers
 Write clean, scalable, well-tested, and maintainable code following engineering best practices
 Take ownership of projects and deliver features end-to-end in a fast-paced environment
 
 Required Experience 
 Strong foundation in: Python
 React
 REST APIs
 SQL
 Snowflake
 AWS RDS / PostgreSQL / MySQL
 Git and modern development workflows
 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 High work ethic with exceptional attention to detail
 Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment
 Exposure to AWS or other cloud infrastructure
 Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, or modern software delivery practices
 Interest in AI/LLMs, data engineering, or automation technologies
 Experience building applications within Treasury, Finance, or Capital Markets environments is advantageous
 
 Ideal Candidate 
 Smart, driven, and intellectually curious
 Comfortable wearing multiple hats and working across technical and business teams
 Enjoys solving complex technical and business problems
 Takes ownership and delivers high-quality solutions with minimal supervision
 Thrives in a collaborative, high-performance engineering environment
 

 Compensation 
 Jain Global offers a total compensation package which includes a base salary, discretionary bonus, and comprehensive benefits. The estimated base salary range for this position is $200,000 to $240,000, which is specific to New York and may change in the future. When finalizing an offer, we take into consideration an individual’s experience level and the qualifications they bring to the role to formulate a competitive total compensation package.


 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer 
 As an employer, we believe every individual brings unique diversity of thought and perspective that enriches Jain Global's teams and drives competitive performance. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can make meaningful contributions.
